description.narrative: Getmobil Teknoloji Anonim Sirketi (Getmobil or the Company) is a smartphone refurbishment platform serving the Turkish market. The Company operates a B2B platform, which provides end-to-end digital infrastructure to offline SME smartphone vendors enabling them to source used electronics, refurbish them as per government standards and sell them to customers nationwide via digital channels. Getmobil also has a retail presence through its B2C e-commerce platform, Getmobil.com. IFC is considering an equity investment of up to US$6 million in Getmobil (the Project). The funding will support Getmobils expansion in Türkiye.

IFC anticipates that the Project will result in improved access to markets for Small and Medium Enterprises (SME) in the second-hand technology retail sector in Türkiye, resulting in revenue growth and productivity gains, and improved access to affordable quality handset devices. The Company is expanding a digital platform that enables the sales and refurbishment of second-hand handset devices by linking SMEs to certified refurbishment centers, providing Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) tools, financing, and digital payments to expand reach, boost revenues, and support formalization. For consumers, the platform offers affordable, high-quality refurbished handsets priced below both new devices and refurbished options of similar quality while ensuring consistent standards. Beyond the Project, IFC anticipates that the Companys expansion will promote greater competitiveness of the market for refurbished electronic devices in Türkiye, by deepening the digital refurbished electronics segment, via demonstration and replication channels.
